question: ip-proxy/airproxy-mobile: rewrite the statements that the vendor's /en/ page contradicts: egress.terms and egress.free_allowance (no traffic statement found), the paragraph of the notes on why no monthly price is readable, and the proved text of the three 404 evidence rows ('documented absence').
why: The raw HTML of https://airproxy.io/en/ fetched on 2026-11-02 (the reader view of the same URL returns only the FAQ) states 'Unlimited data' with 'No fixed limits, no throttling and low latencies', lists 'Unlimited Bandwith' under the EUR 67 per proxy per 30 days plan, and its meta description names unlimited bandwidth, API access and speeds up to 90mbps. The unit that added extras.price_monthly corrected free_tier.stated, free_tier.notes and price_per_tb_month only; the egress fields, interface_detail (API access is named, no protocol was read), extras.price_reported and the notes are unchanged. The purchase URL redirects to the signup form (final URL https://airproxy.io/en/accounts/signup/?next=/en/accounts/profile/purchase/), which carries both the VAT number or Fiscal Code line and the ID-and-selfie recommendation, so the caveat in the proved text of the purchase evidence row about which URL carried the identity sentence can be settled.
